$comment: jetstore-owned-asset: data_model/jets_agentic.schema.json — DO NOT EDIT. Source: `jets-agentic generate`, from tools/jets_agentic/jets_agentic/model.py. Installed into this workspace at image build time and overwritten on every build; a local edit is lost, and the build fails rather than clobbering it silently. Extend the model from your own file that imports this one.
description: The jets_agentic domain model, version 0.1.0. Decode against `jets-agentic schema` projections, not whole entities.

AgentRun.description:
One execution of one agent: the unit the audit store correlates on
(§7.2's run_id) and the carrier of the reproducibility fields the
proposal's generated_by block names (§A.2.7).

run_id.description: The run identity; agent_audit.run_id correlates to it.

agent_version.description: The agent's version, for reproducibility (§A.2.7 generated_by).

model_id.description: The model that served the run.

tier.description: The autonomy tier the run executed under, recorded not enforced (§9.1).

ended_at.description: When the run ended; unset while running.

run_status.description: The run outcome: succeeded, exhausted, interrupted or failed; unset while running (scoped per F7: status is §A.2.7's name on Incident). Corrected at D.5: this read 'succeeded, failed, interrupted' while the loop wrote 'exhausted' - the budget running out is not a failure, it is the compile-pass rate's denominator - and never wrote 'interrupted' until the same task gave it a wall-clock cap to distinguish from a caller's cancellation.

triggered_by.description: What started the run: a schedule, an anomaly, a user (scoped per F7: trigger_ref is §A.2.10's name on ChangeProposal).

domain_model_version.description: The domain model version the run reasoned against (§5.3).

iteration_cap.description: Maximum propose-verify-repair iterations before the run ends as exhausted; the bound §7's Rung 3 asks for without saying by what.

wall_clock_cap_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds for the whole run, carried on the run's context; the only cap that bounds a call the request timeout missed.

token_spend.description: Total tokens consumed by the run, accumulated from the inference responses; unset while running. Recorded rather than capped in phase 1 - it is what lets the eval harness compare sampling policies at equal spend (§4.3).

Anomaly.description:
A deterministic detector's observation (§A.2.6). Skeleton: identity and
detection time; the signal fields arrive with the Observer agent.

ApprovalEvent.description:
One human or agent decision on a supervised subject: the supervision
seam. Outcomes are appended, never updated — a decision is a new event
referencing the same subject (§7.2).

run_ref.description: The AgentRun this event belongs to (scoped per F7: run_id names the run's own identity).

subject_ref.description: The Remediation or ChangeProposal being decided.

from_state.description: The approval state before the decision.

to_state.description: The approval state after the decision.

actor.description: Who decided: a user_email or an agent identity.

tier_at_event.description: The autonomy tier at the time of the event (§7.2; scoped per F7).

decision_rationale.description: Why, in the actor's words (scoped per F7: rationale is §A.2.10's name on ChangeProposal).

AutonomyTier.description:
§A.4. Lexicographic order is tier order — the ceiling comparisons of
gap 7 work on the text directly, so do not relabel to the §9.2 names and
do not exceed T9 (§4).

ChangeProposal.description:
A proposed code or configuration change (§A.2.10), flattened to scalar
and array properties: code_diff, ci_result and impact_analysis are nested
objects in the schema and JetRules has no anonymous nested object.

trigger.description: What prompted the proposal (§A.4 ChangeTrigger vocabulary; carried as text in Phase 0 — the vocabulary ships with its consumer).

trigger_ref.description: Incident, drift detection, or backlog item.

code_diff_files_changed.description: code_diff.files_changed of §A.2.10. Corrected at D.7: declared list[str] with default=None, which Pydantic does not validate and which the DDL emitter read as required-and-defaulted-to-null - two claims that cannot both hold. The default says the intent was optional.

assumptions_made.description: The assumptions the proposal rests on. Corrected at D.7 with code_diff_files_changed, same defect.

generated_tests.description: The tests generated with the change (min 1).

approval_state.description: Where the proposal sits in the approval lifecycle.

proposal_model_version.description: The domain model version the proposal was generated against (scoped per F7; domain_model_version stays on AgentRun).

DomainModelVersion.description:
A released version of the domain model itself (proposal §5.3: identity
and intent given, fields ours). Skeleton: the version and when it took
effect.

version.description: The semantic version of the model release.

effective_at.description: When this version became the current one.

EvalCase.description:
One evaluation case of the assurance suite (ours; §11's consumer
arrives in a later phase). Skeleton: identity only.

Evidence.description:
One evidence item of a Hypothesis (§A.2.8 `$defs`): a value object in
working memory, so §B.3's escalation trigger — contradictory evidence
exceeding supporting — is a rule-countable fact rather than a JSON blob.

source_ref.description: A resolvable reference into the source.

EvidenceSource.description:
§A.2.8's `$defs` — scoped to Evidence and deliberately NOT in §A.4,
which is why the emitters discover vocabularies by reachability (9 values).

Hypothesis.description:
A causal hypothesis for an Incident (§A.2.8): the RCA agent's output
contract (§B.3). contradicting_evidence is required — a calibration
control, not a documentation nicety (§A.2.8's own note).

rank.description: The rank among the incident's hypotheses, 1-based.

contradicting_evidence.description: The evidence against — required; empty only where the agent explicitly asserts none exists (§A.2.8).

Incident.description:
A triaged cluster of anomalies (§A.2.7). Skeleton: identity, lifecycle
and the classification trio; the impact and generated_by fields arrive
with their consumer.

status.description: Where the incident sits in §A.5's state machine.

incident_model_version.description: §A.2.7's domain_model_version, scoped per F7: the model version the incident was raised against.

IncidentClassification.description: §A.4 — the causal taxonomy of an incident (10 values).

IncidentStatus.description: §A.4 — the incident lifecycle (11 values); the state machine is §A.5's.

Remediation.description:
A proposed corrective action (§A.2.9). Skeleton: identity, the incident
it corrects, and the two governing states.

incident_ref.description: The Incident this remediates (§A.2.9 names it incident_id; scoped per F7 against Incident's identity).

autonomy_tier_required.description: The tier the action requires (recorded; enforcement is by privilege, §9.1).

remediation_approval_state.description: Where the remediation sits in the approval lifecycle (§A.2.9 names it approval_state; scoped per F7 against ChangeProposal's).
